name: Dicksons God Took Best Angels Nurse Figurine (8 in)
seoTitle: God Made Nurses Angel Figurine Gift
metaDescription: An 8 inch white resin figurine saying God took the best angels and made nurses. A heartfelt keepsake for a retiring nurse or a nurse who cared for family.
summary: A white resin figurine with a faith based message, a heartfelt keepsake for retirement, Nurses Week, or thanking a nurse who cared for someone you love.
whyItWorks: Families often want to thank the nurse who stayed with their mother through a long illness or sat with them during a hard night. A figurine with the message that God took the best angels and made nurses gives that gratitude a physical form, something that can sit on a shelf at home long after the hospital stay is over.

At 8 inches tall it has enough presence to stand on a dresser or bookshelf without taking over the room, and the white finish keeps it soft and classic. It suits a retirement party, where a decades long career deserves a keepsake, or a hospice nurse who rarely gets lasting thanks. Since figurines are personal decor, it works best for someone whose style leans sentimental. Include a card with the patient's name and a few words about what their care meant.
goodToKnow: Resin can chip if dropped, so wrap it well if you are shipping or carrying it to a party.
The message is religious, so it suits a nurse who shares that faith.
Check the listing photos for the exact pose and lettering before ordering.

faq.q: Is this a good retirement gift for a nurse?
faq.a: Yes, it is a lasting keepsake that honors a long career, especially for a nurse with sentimental decor taste.

faq.q: Can it be displayed at work?
faq.a: It could sit on a nurses station or office desk, but most recipients keep figurines like this at home.
